question: When I discover, is exiling cards from the top of my library optional?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you must exile cards; only casting the card or putting it into your hand is optional.
expected.answer: When you discover, you must exile cards. The only optional part of the ability is whether you cast the exiled card or put it into your hand.
